name: Brennus's Taberna
player_description: Ground floor: four tables, a timber bar counter, a clay hearth, and a side room Brennus calls his office (it contains a stool, a box of receipts, and a locked chest). Upper floor: four rooms to rent. The kitchen runs from before dawn until the fire goes out. Half the fort eats here at least once a week.
gm_notes: DC 12 Persuasion (or buying a round): Brennus names one soldier currently in debt and to whom. DC 15 Persuasion (buying a full evening's round): he shares that he owes a specific Germanic trader a substantial favour — Sigrun is the trader, the connection has a name and a use. DC 18 Persuasion (Ally tier + previous relationship): Brennus reveals the false-bottom chest contents: a half-finished letter addressed to a name in Carnuntum that the party will recognize from the dispatch chest in the Legate's quarters. The letter concerns the spear. Accessing the black market requires Trusted tier or 50 denarii access fee. Current black market stock: 2 doses henbane sedative (20d each), one set Germanic civilian clothing (soldier's size), three bottles of Legate-requisitioned wine (blackmail potential). Brennus pause beat: when he shares the DC 18 revelation, he goes to the back room first. He places folded papyrus on the bar and covers it with his hand until the party acknowledges the conversation did not happen. Then he lifts his hand.
